name: murmur-monorepo
description: Murmur — social-simulation engine for coding agents. Zero API keys; inference rides your existing coding subscription via MCP.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @murmur/engine && npm run build -w @murmur/prompts && npm run build -w @murmur/adapters && npm run build -w @murmur/templates && npm run build -w murmur-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @murmur/engine && npm run build -w @murmur/prompts && npm run build -w @murmur/adapters && npm run build -w @murmur/templates
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --project e2e
